packageRules.description: One PR per dep — matches existing per-dependency Linear-ticket cadence

Pin Docker base image digests (UNK-254). Tags stay human-readable; the appended @sha256 digest gives tamper-evidence and reproducible buildkit cache behaviour. Scoped to Docker managers only — cargo/npm lockfiles already pin transitively. Digest bumps auto-merge via the auto-merge rule below: they stay libc-ABI-compatible within a Debian codename, and a sha256 bump cannot be meaningfully human-reviewed anyway (the reviewer cannot inspect layer contents from the digest). Note: minimumReleaseAge does NOT gate pin/digest update types (Renovate limitation), so digest bumps land within one schedule window with CI-green as the only check. Acceptable because all bases are Docker Official Images.
Auto-merge patch updates for GitHub Actions and Docker base images (low-risk regardless of version)
Auto-merge patch updates for stable (v1.0.0+) cargo and npm dependencies. Pre-v1.0 (0.x.y) deps stay manual — SemVer isn't binding below 1.0 and Rust/npm 0.x patches can include behavioural changes

Pin rand_core_06 cargo alias at v0.6 — the alias name explicitly documents the deliberate version pin (v0.6 API is required by a transitive crypto consumer). Any bump silently breaks the pin intent and gets closed manually (see PR #122). Revisit if the alias is removed from Cargo.toml

customManagers.description: Rust-crate tools pinned inline via taiki-e/install-action `with: tool: <crate>@<ver>` syntax. install-action's manifest silently advances unpinned tools, so the project pins versions inline. Renovate's github-actions manager doesn't reach inside `with:` values, so without this manager those pins stay frozen. Hand-listed depNames avoid false matches on any non-Rust install-action entry that might appear later (today's only one is cargo-nextest; sqlx-cli uses a different idiom — see the second manager).

sqlx-cli is pinned via a job-level SQLX_CLI_VERSION env var rather than install-action's `tool:` syntax (PR #288 moved it because install-action has no sqlx-cli manifest and was falling through to a 2-minute cargo install — the env var is now the single source of truth referenced by both the actions/cache key and the cargo install fallback). The env-var form doesn't match the `tool:` regex, so it needs its own manager. depNameTemplate hard-codes the crate name because the env-var name alone isn't crate-shaped.
